🎬 **CASTING CALL: CLACK** 🎬 *Clack* is an intimate, darkly playful short centered around two young women caught in an increasingly provocative guessing game. What begins as teasing slowly shifts into something more seductive and dangerous, as one character begins to draw the other further out of her comfort zone.

We are casting for **TWO FEMALE LEADS**:

👉 **JEAN**
* **Playing age:** Mid-20s
* **Description:** Magnetic, confident, and mischievous. She has an almost "devil on your shoulder" energy – playful, provocative, and always slightly in control.

👉 **[TBC / SECOND LEAD]**
* **Playing age:** Mid-20s
* **Description:** Warm, curious, and initially more reserved. There is an innocence to her, but throughout the scene we begin to see her drawn into the other woman's world.

🎥 **STYLE & NOTE:** The film will be shot in a very intimate visual style, using close-ups and extreme close-ups to build chemistry, tension, and a playful sense of danger between the characters. **(NO PHYSICAL TOUCH)**

📅 **DETAILS:**
* **Shoot Date:** Tuesday, 24 November 2026
* **Shoot Location:** Edinburgh - exact location TBC
* **Compensation:** Unpaid student film – bus fare, lunch, and snacks will be provided

⏳ **APPLY BY FRIDAY, 6 NOVEMBER (12:00)!** To apply, please send a headshot, acting CV/showreel (if available), and a short introduction to: 📧 **40853404@live.napier.ac.uk**

#CastingCall #FilmEdinburgh #EdinburghNapier #ScreenAcademyScotland #ShortFilm #ActorsWanted #FemaleLeads

We had a great first reading on Sunday - still looking for a few more "recovery peeps" to join us!!!

Casting Call - “Saving the Timothy” - A modern drunken, drug-addled retelling of A Christmas Carol. 
Logline
A washed-up, addiction-ravaged Hollywood director returns to his small-town Canadian theatre roots to stage A Christmas Carol, where the spectre of his late partner forces him through a dark, hallucinatory journey across his past, present, and future toward redemption and sobriety.
Are you an aspiring or experienced actor with lived experience of addiction?
No previous theatre experience required — all skill levels welcome!
About the Project
Casting is open to everyone, regardless of age, race, gender, or ability.
Supportive & Peer-Led: A safe creative environment focused on personal growth, personal expression, and storytelling.
Collaborative Performance: Work together with fellow community members to bring stories to life in a live public staged reading.
Key Dates & Location

Rehearsals: Sundays — November 8, 15, 22, 29 (2:00 PM – 6:00 PM)
Staged Reading Performance: Saturday, December 5, 2026
Location: The Vancouver Recovery Club, 2775 Sophia St, Vancouver, BC
How to Apply & Join
Application Deadline: October 30, 2026
Email Submission: Submit an introduction letter, selfie/headshot & experience to hello@therecoveredartscollective.org
Online Application: Apply directly via Google Form Application: https://forms.gle/vHdYxLYL5A9JuGhbA #soberaf #recoveroutloud #recoveryispossible #addictionrecovery #endthestigma

🎬 **CASTING CALL – BEN | A MISTAKE (Short Film)**

We're still accepting submissions for an actor to play **Ben** in our upcoming dark comedy short film, *A Mistake*, shooting in Central Burnaby on **November 18th**!

**LOGLINE**
Two friends bond over the struggles of dating and being single while on a hike, but things take an awkward turn when one jokingly suggests they start dating each other and the other doesn't take it well.

**ROLE AVAILABLE**

**BEN | Late 20s | Open ethnicity**

A bit awkward, literal, and straightforward, with a dry sense of humour. Ben and Sarah were friends in high school but drifted apart after graduation. He's been single for a while and figures he has nothing to lose by jokingly suggesting they start dating, but the conversation takes an unexpected turn.

**PRODUCTION DETAILS**

📍 Location: Central Burnaby, BC
📅 Shoot date: November 18th, 2026
💰 Compensation: Volunteer, with demo reel material, photos, IMDb credit, and food provided on set
🎭 Open to UBCP/ACTRA members and non-union performers
📩 Submission deadline: November 6th, 2026

**HOW TO APPLY**
Please email your headshot, demo reel (if available), and resume to **amistakeshortfilm@gmail.com**.

Use the subject line: **[Your Name] – Ben Audition**

Shortlisted applicants will receive self-tape instructions.

Please feel free to share with anyone who might be a good fit. Thanks!

🎬 CASTING CALL: KEYS OF PRIDE | Deadline for Submissions: November 4, 2026
We are casting two male actors for our upcoming short film shooting between November 26-30, 2026 (total dates vary based on actor role).

🗒️ LOGLINE

Told through two parallel perspectives, a tiger mom’s push for perfection and her son’s desire for freedom collide, revealing the painful gap between intention and impact, and the tragic cost of misunderstood love.

🎭 ROLES

JULIAN | East Asian (Chinese) | 15-18 (Actors 18+ welcome)

Must be able to understand spoken Mandarin Chinese. Ability to play piano is a plus. 

A sensitive, introspective teenager struggling to discover who he is and what he truly wants while living under the weight of his mother's high expectations. Torn between fulfilling the future envisioned for him and finding his own identity, he silently battles the emotional toll of years of pressure. 

[Acting Requirement]

Strong emotional range and the ability to convey complex, suppressed emotions through facial expressions and body language, particularly in scenes with little to no dialogue. The actor must be comfortable communicating internal conflict and emotional vulnerability through subtle, non-verbal performance.

[Content Warning]

The character's storyline involves suicide (implied, will not be shown on-screen).

YOUNG JULIAN | East Asian (Chinese) | 8-10

Ability to play piano is a plus. 

A bright, cheerful, and spirited young boy with an infectious youthful energy. Though still full of innocence and curiosity, he is beginning to feel the weight of his mother's overbearing expectations and increasingly rigid rules.

✍️ SUBMISSIONS INSTRUCTIONS

Please submit your headshot, acting resume, and demo reel (if available) to keysofpride@gmail.com.

Subject line: CHARACTER NAME – FIRSTNAMELASTNAME

Audition sides and further instructions will be provided to shortlisted candidates only.

Please note this is a volunteer/unpaid role. Actors will receive edited footage for demo reels, behind-the-scenes photos, meals on set, and IMDb credit.

CASTING CALL – WEDNESDAY THE BLOOD BALL🖤
Studentischer Kurzfilm der Lazi Filmakademie Esslingen

Wir suchen unsere Hauptdarstellerin!

Für unseren studentischen Kurzfilm *Wednesday – The Blood Ball* suchen wir eine Darstellerin für die Hauptrolle Wednesday.

Der etwa 3–4-minütige Film zeigt eine düstere Gothic-Ballsaal-Szene mit einer markanten Tanzsequenz und einem anschließenden Blutregen-Effekt. Unsere eigene Inszenierung orientiert sich visuell an der bekannten Tanzszene aus der Netflix-Serie Wednesday.

DIE ROLLE

Wednesday ist die zentrale Figur des Films. Besonders wichtig sind ihre charakteristischen Tanzbewegungen, Posen und ihre ausdrucksstarke Körpersprache.

Was du mitbringen solltest:

- Gutes Körper- und Rhythmusgefühl sowie flüssige, kontrollierte Bewegungen.

- Ausdrucksstarke Mimik und Körpersprache.

- Die Fähigkeit, die Tanzbewegungen der Referenz möglichst präzise einzustudieren.

- Bereitschaft zu Kostüm, Make-up und Haarstyling sowie zur Teilnahme an der Blutregen-Szene.

Du musst keine professionelle Tänzerin sein. Die Umsetzung der Choreografie ist uns wichtiger als eine perfekte optische Ähnlichkeit.

TANZREFERENZ

Als Orientierung dient die Tanzszene aus der Serie:

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NakTu_VZxJ0](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NakTu_VZxJ0)

Bitte studiere die Bewegungen und Posen für dein Bewerbungsvideo ein.

DAS BRAUCHEN WIR VON DIR

1. Porträtfoto und Ganzkörperfoto

Zwei aktuelle Fotos, auf denen dein Gesicht beziehungsweise deine gesamte Person gut erkennbar sind.

2. Vorstellungsvideo (max 60 Sekunden)

Stelle dich kurz vor und erzähle uns:

- Wie heißt du und woher kommst du?

- Warum interessiert dich die Rolle Wednesday?

- Was reizt dich an der Tanz-Challenge?

3. Tanzvideo – besonders wichtig

Zeige uns, wie du die Tanzbewegungen und Posen anhand der Referenz nachstellen kannst.

- Möglichst eine durchgehende, ungeschnittene Aufnahme.

- Kopf und Füße müssen während des Tanzes sichtbar sein.

- Normale Geschwindigkeit, keine Filter oder KI-Manipulationen.

- Einfache Smartphone-Aufnahmen reichen vollkommen aus.

PROJEKT UND RAHMENBEDINGUNGEN

- Drehregion:  Esslingen / Stuttgart

- Geplanter Dreh:  Nacht vom 9. auf den 10. Januar 2027 (noch nicht endgültig bestätigt)

- Produktion:  Studentischer No-Budget-Kurzfilm

- Gage:  Leider nicht möglich

- Verpflegung:  Essen und Getränke am Set

- Anreise / Unterkunft:   Kann nach Absprache geprüft werden, ist jedoch nicht garantiert.

**Wichtiger Hinweis:** Während der Blutregen-Szene können Gesicht, Haare und Kleidung mit roter Effektflüssigkeit nass und sichtbar verschmutzt werden. Flecken lassen sich möglicherweise nicht vollständig entfernen.

BEWERBUNG

Bitte sende deine Bewerbung mit dem Betreff **WEDNESDAY CASTING – Vorname Nachname** an:

**[wednesday.bloodball.casting@gmail.com](mailto\:wednesday.bloodball.casting@gmail.com)**

Kleinere Dateien kannst du direkt anhängen. Größere Videos bitte über einen Freigabelink (z. B. Google Drive) bereitstellen. Bitte gib außerdem deinen Wohnort und deine Verfügbarkeit für den geplanten Dreh an.

- **Bewerbungsschluss:** Sonntag, 22. November 2026

- **Rückmeldung zur Besetzung:** spätestens Sonntag, 29. November 2026

Bei Interesse können wir anschließend ein kurzes Online-Gespräch vereinbaren.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

*Deine Bewerbungsunterlagen werden ausschließlich für das Casting verwendet und nur den daran beteiligten Personen zugänglich gemacht. Informationen zur Speicherung und Löschung erhältst du über die Kontaktadresse.*

# 🎭 SHOGUNS THEATER – CASTING 2026 🎭

 Schauspielerin gesucht für die Hauptrolle „Eva"

 Für das moderne Bewusstseins-Theaterstück

DIE SCHÖPFUNG

Kein religiöses Theater.
Keine klassische Bibelinszenierung.

„Die Schöpfung“** ist ein modernes, philosophisches Bühnenwerk über Bewusstsein, Ursprung, Menschsein, Freiheit, Licht & Schatten. Ein emotionales, poetisches und kraftvolles Theatererlebnis zwischen Symbolik, Schauspiel, Körperausdruck und innerer Wahrheit.

Gesucht wird eine ausdrucksstarke Schauspielerin im Alter von 20 bis 47 Jahren für die Rolle **Eva** – sowie für mehrere symbolische Nebenrollen innerhalb des Stücks.

✨ Was ich suche

Eine Schauspielerin mit:

* starker Bühnenpräsenz
* emotionaler Tiefe
* Mut zur Ausdruckskraft
* Offenheit für modernes, intensives Theater
* Interesse an bewusstseinsorientierter Kunst

Die Rolle „Eva“ verkörpert nicht Religion – sondern den Ursprung des Menschen, Weiblichkeit, Erkenntnis, Freiheit und Bewusstsein.

 🎭 Wichtiger Hinweis zur Rolle

Für einzelne Szenen der Inszenierung sollte die Darstellerin keine Hemmungen gegenüber künstlerischer Nacktheit haben.
Die Darstellung erfolgt ästhetisch, symbolisch und theaterkünstlerisch – niemals vulgär oder voyeuristisch.
Körperlichkeit dient ausschließlich der künstlerischen Aussage des Stücks.

 📍 CASTING – November 

13.11/ 14.11/ 21.11/22.11

Gesucht werden sowohl erfahrene Schauspielerinnen als auch starke neue Persönlichkeiten mit natürlicher Ausstrahlung.

Gage pro Auftritt Fr. 500 ( 3 Auftritte in Planung)
Gage Netto Proben Fr. 1700

Es handelt sich um ein Pilotprojekt wenn eine Tournee daraus erfolgt wären bis 30 Auftritte vorgesehen

Aufführungen sind Rickenbach SO Schweiz
 📩 Bewerbung an:

[wehrlipeter4@gmail.com

oder über die Homepage:

https://der-mensch-neue-erkentnisse.jimdosite.com/

 SHOGUNS THEATER
 „Theater darf nicht nur unterhalten.
Es darf erinnern, erschüttern und Bewusstsein erschaffen.“

**🎤 BEZAHLTE INTERVIEWER-JOBMÖGLICHKEIT – DEUTSCHLAND 🇩🇪**

Wir suchen eine offene, selbstbewusste und charismatische Person, die für **Breathe Lio**, eine Marke, die Menschen beim Rauchstopp unterstützt, Straßeninterviews in Deutschland durchführt!

📍 **Standort:** Du solltest in einer deutschen Großstadt leben (Berlin, Hamburg, München, Köln, Frankfurt etc.).

💰 **Vergütung:** 50 € pro Stunde

⏰ **Dauer:** Ca. 3 Stunden pro Einsatz (150 € insgesamt)

📅 **Perspektive:** Mehrere Einsätze pro Monat möglich!

**Was du mitbringen solltest:**
* Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder fließendem Niveau
* Selbstbewusstes Auftreten und keine Scheu, fremde Menschen anzusprechen
* Offen, spontan und sympathisch vor der Kamera
* Erfahrung mit Straßeninterviews oder Content Creation ist ein Plus!

Wenn die ersten Interviews gut laufen, freuen wir uns auf eine **langfristige Zusammenarbeit** mit regelmäßigen Einsätzen!

**Interesse?** Schick uns eine kurze Vorstellung, deinen Wohnort und gerne Beispiele deiner bisherigen Arbeit.

🌐 [www.breathelio.com](http://www.breathelio.com/)

items.text:
Hello all,
I am looking for a team of filmmakers with basic equipment for a short film, to join my project.

I am also looking for actors to join the team.

I would like to find the team first, and then hold a sounding board to see how the idea/concept for the film can develop realistically and pan out. 

I am hoping to submit for the Reed Earth Raise Impact Film Fund to help fund the making of the film, but first I would like to find a team I know I can be confident going forward with for the application. :) 

I am Burnley based, but am happy to work with anybody in the Greater Manchester areas and surrounding Lancashire areas near me. The film's shooting locations is yet to be confirmed once I find a team to make this happen with. :) 

Please reply to this post, or email me at: c.scoon@yandex.com if interested, letting me know a bit about yourself, your CV or showreels, location, age etc, and whether you have access to any filmmaking equipment. 

Thank you muchly <3

Do kolejnego listopadowego odcinka 2. sezonu fabularnego serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję aktorów do następujących ról:

1.Bocian (35) – postawny, łysy, tatuaże, agresywny, porywczy, typ gangusa  - prawo jazdy
Data: 11 i 12. listopada
Stawka: 1600 zł netto za całość

2.„Pilczak” (39) – szczupły, wysoki, może mieć tatuaże, blizny, dłuższe włosy
Data: 11 i 12. listopada
Stawka: 1600 zł netto za całość

3.Ilona (39) – żona Pawła. Skromna, przestraszona całą sytuacją. Skromnie ubrana, lekki makijaż lub brak.
Data: 11 listopada
Stawka: 800 zł netto

4.Witek(58) – serdeczny, dobry człowiek. Zmartwiony losem konkurent. Ubrany w ubranie robocze.  
Data: 11 listopada
Stawka: 700 zł netto

5.Artur (27) – pracownik lakierni samochodowej. Dobrze zbudowany, postawny, krótkie włosy. Konkretny, chętnie rozmawia z policją.
Data: 11 listopada
Stawka: 600 zł netto

6.Bartek (32) – pracownik w lakierni samochodowej oraz informator policji. Szczupły, lubi biegać, krótkie włosy, ubrany w sportowe ubrania.
Data: 11 i 12 listopada 
Stawka: 1400 zł netto za całość

7.Stróż (60) – stróż pracujący na złomowisku. Ciekawski, interesuje się wszystkim dookoła. 
Data: 12 listopada
Stawka: 400 zł netto

8.Gangster 3 (41) – Gangster zatrzymany na złomowisku. Wysoki, chudy, tatuaże. Na początku nie chce pracować z policją, ale dociśnięty sypie wszystkich współpracowników.
Data: 12 i 13 listopada
Stawka: 1600 zł netto za całość

Chętnych aktorów zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania
9. Data lub odcinek grania w pierwszym sezonie Gliniarzy Śląsk

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

AUDITIONS FOR DE KOVEN'S LIGHT OPERA: ROBIN HOOD

Music by Reginald De Koven - Libretto by Harry B. Smith

Auditions are held at Avon Free Public Library - Board Room on 2nd Floor at 281 Country Club Road, Avon, Connecticut 06001. Audition: Nov 21st [3:00 pm - 5:00 pm] & Nov 24th [6:00 PM - 8:00 PM] Please prepare 32 measures, please provide your own backing 

Rehearsals: 

Rehearsals: Mondays and Wednesdays nights starting Jan 18th [5pm to 8pm]

Tech: March 15-17. [5pm - 8pm]

Performances: March 19 (7pm) & 20 (7pm) at The Canton Community Baptist Church - 125 Dowd Ave, Canton, CT 06019

Volunteer, Non Union, No Travel or Board Provided

[https://forms.gle/fCEtvFAtrtTHAyAc6](https://forms.gle/fCEtvFAtrtTHAyAc6?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAcGRvZgVicmlkETFoNHgwMEQ4eTExRkNscVRSc3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABH-MGU0DmGHeFQ3Ub7LG9Vamy1555kYKnDrGCPYPpz6c62emI0nTESNxp8WH4_aem_6BOG4zlGkhqVz97drZ2w4A)

Robert, Earl of Huntington, wins the admiration of the outlaws by his marksmanship, whilst the Sheriff of Nottingham repudiates his claims to the Earldom and declares Guy of Gisborne the real heir. Robert joins the outlaws and becomes the celebrated Robin Hood. Lady Marian has been commanded by the King to wed the Earl of Huntington and comes in disguise to see what sort of man he may be. With Robert she is well pleased, and they plight their troth, but when the wily Sheriff substitutes Guy as the Earl, Lady Marian conceals the King’s decrees, commanding her to marry him.

FLIGHTTIME PRODUCTIONS

FINAL OPEN CASTING CALL

DIVA AIRWAYS: THE RISE & FALL

A Three-Act Comedy-Drama | World Premiere — Chicago, 2027

NON-UNION ACTORS ONLY | PAID ROLES

FlightTime Productions is seeking talented and dedicated performers for its upcoming world-premiere production of Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall, written and directed by Matthew Stevens.

Join us for this exciting original comedy-drama filled with laughter, friendship, family, workplace rivalries, and unexpected turbulence!

OPEN AUDITION INFORMATION

Monday, November 9, 2026

11:00 AM – 4:00 PM

West Loop Branch Library — Meeting Room

122 N. Aberdeen Street

Chicago, IL 60607

NO APPOINTMENT NECESSARY!

Audition check-in closes promptly at 4:00 PM.

AVAILABLE ROLES

All roles offer an $800 performance stipend.

* COLIN (16+) — Alexa’s caring younger brother, struggling with complicated family relationships.

* TIFFANY BELMONT (16+) — Miss Brooks’ stylish, ambitious, outspoken, and hilariously unpredictable assistant.

* BROOKLYN (16+) — The rival airline CEO’s daughter, whose loyalty begins to shift toward Diva Airways.

* SABRINA (25+) — A hardworking, loyal airline lounge manager confronting the company’s financial challenges.

AUDITION REQUIREMENTS

Please prepare a 1–2 minute comedic or dramatic monologue and bring a current headshot and acting résumé. Performers will also participate in group improvisation activities.

CALLBACKS — BY INVITATION ONLY

Friday, November 13, 2026 | 10:00 AM

Pullman Branch Library

11001 S. Indiana Avenue

Chicago, IL 60628

REHEARSALS & PERFORMANCES

Rehearsals Begin: January 10, 2027

Technical Rehearsals: April 4–7, 2027

Performance Engagement: April 8 – May 30, 2027

QUESTIONS & CASTING INQUIRIES

divaairwaysstage@gmail.com

Please note: West Loop Branch Library is not affiliated with or a sponsor of this production.

FLIGHTTIME PRODUCTIONS

Where the drama is first class, the comedy is nonstop, and the turbulence is guaranteed!

items.text:
Television Comedy Writer Seeking Representation by Agent or Manager
TLTR: Looking for agent/manager in television comedy for original pilots and a reboot project

Hello everyone (bots included)! My name is Cheyenne L. Harlow, an LA transplant from Georgia, pursuing representation by an agent or manager specialized in television comedy. I am both an actress, sitcom writer, and standup comedian with a lengthy educational background in Theatre and Improv.  

I’ve lived in the nitty gritty of LA for the past four years, working two, sometimes three jobs at a time, on a daily bus commute filled to the brim with characters. With those experiences, one can safely assume I primarily write about working class people who are simply trying to survive in a society set out against them, and they’d be correct. Add a few oddball misfits and you have a comedy. One of my pilots encapsulates that idea perfectly in an oddly comforting love letter to LA. 

I’m also fondly inspired by nostalgic sitcoms that I grew up with as a millennial raised by their grandmother, following into shows beyond my age, such as, Golden Girls, Threes Company, The Brady Bunch, Gilligans Island, I Dream of Jeannie, I Love Lucy, and so many other classics. 

That’s why it only made sense when one of my comforting escapes from reality became my fuel to write comedy. 

At the age of 10, I had fallen in love with the idea of bringing this universe back to life with a new set of circumstances. In 2017, while studying theatre in college, I voiced this aloud to one of my classmates that sparked that thought into a full-fledged concept. 

Between then and now, I was reaching out to the show-runner of The Nanny on social media. He responded with appreciation, but also the urge to find representation prior to pitch. Something tells me that he greatly underestimated how dedicated I was to bringing this project to life. I packed my life up in Georgia in 2022, moved to Los Angeles in 2023 and I’ve been here ever since. 

Upon a kismet happenstance, I met the showrunner of The Nanny in pure coincidence within my first few months in Los Angeles, back in 2023, on Mother’s Day.

By 2026, my concept had aged itself out and I had to adapt, using a new concept with the same bones to it. Stronger than ever. I was recovering from gastric sleeve surgery, out of a 9-5 job, and it seemed like a better time than ever to do what I set out to do. I wrote six episodes, revised, all in three months. I had colleagues and fellow writers read it over and over for feedback. Now, it only needs to land in front of the right eyes to represent it for pitching. 

I have multiple original pilots accompanied by their visual pitch decks and series bibles. The reboot itself supported by even more, granted it’s been in the making for several years.

If you’ve read to the end of this long spiel, I truly appreciate it. For those who have issue with the length, I can only assume aren’t who it’s for. I’m hoping that anyone networking in LA has the right connections to make this pitch a reality for me and I’d be forever indebted to anyone who can push me in the right direction. 

Love, Cheyenne ✨💖

🎬 CASTING CALL — THE BALLAD OF BULLS
Independent micro film seeking actors in Vancouver, the Lower Mainland, and Fraser Valley, BC!

📖 ABOUT THE FILM

After disappearing for seven years, a legendary underworld enforcer known as Bulls returns home hoping to reconnect with his estranged sister and leave his violent past behind. But when a dangerous criminal kidnaps a young woman under his sister’s protection and leaves his sister fighting for her life, Bulls is forced back into the world he tried to escape.

🎭 ROLES AVAILABLE

• Ada Dunn: Caucasian female, playing age mid-to-late 20s. Sister of the main character, Michael “Bulls” Dunn.

• Lily: Female, playing age early 20s. Open ethnicity, petite stature (approximately 5’1”–5’4”).

• Sticky Pete: Playing age 20s. Open ethnicity.

• Thugs: Four roles, playing ages 20s–30s. Open ethnicity.

📅 Audition deadline: Extended to November 11

📖 Table read: December 5, 2026

🎥 Filming: January 2027

🎬 Compensation: Unpaid/volunteer opportunity

🍽️ Food provided on set

🎥 Demo footage provided to cast members once the film is completed

📩 HOW TO SUBMIT

For Ada, Lily, and Sticky Pete:

Email jencastingyvr@gmail.com to request the audition sides and instructions. These will be sent directly to interested actors. Once received, please submit your self-taped audition, headshot, and résumé by November 6.

For the Thugs roles:

No audition sides are required. Please email your headshot, résumé, and any existing demo footage.

📌 Please include the role you’re interested in and disclose any scheduling conflicts.

📤 If your video is too large to attach, you can send it via WeTransfer.

📄 For full character descriptions, filming dates, and audition requirements, see the Casting & Audition Information document: 

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Fl4jbRlPtiT3Z_vToloXoCp3jyBwNm-sJAYnjKvtN9M/edit?usp=drivesdk

Thank you! We look forward to seeing your submissions!

items.text:
**CASTING CALL - 5-6 minute industrial documentary — Voice over Narrator **

**Status:** Union, UBCP/ACTRA 

**Location:** British Columbia

**Deadline for submissions: **Tuesday, November 3rd 2026, 5 pm 

**Preferred Recording date:** Thursday, November 5th or Friday, November 6th, 2026 

**Auditions: **Self-tapes. Please send to [info@labourheritagecentre.ca](mailto:info@labourheritagecentre.ca) and cc rleickner@gmail.com. 

**Slate:** Name only 

**Label:** Name_LHC (e.g. Ginger Goodwin_LHC) 

**Specs:** This video will be played at a provincial labour convention and will be posted on YouTube and embedded on the BC Labour Heritage Centre website. It may also be cut down, with clips posted on social media. 

**Rate:** This engagement will be produced under the applicable UBCP/ACTRA Collective Agreement. Please confirm eligibility when submitting. Rates, fees, and working conditions will be in accordance with the collective agreement. Off-camera narration, at a rate of $446.38 for a 1-hour recording

 

**Recording: **Recording in your own pro-quality home studio. Record only; the client will handle editing and processing. 

**Talent: **Open to all BC-based performers over the age of 18 and genders. We encourage members of equity-seeking groups to submit their auditions. 

**Voice description:** A clear voice and an engaging, confident and natural performance that conveys pride in the history of organized labour in British Columbia and hope for its future. Along these lines: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tAkJ30gGz24. 

**Sample script: **

"The fledgling federation was immediately put to the test: The brutal breaking of a Vancouver Island coal miner’s strike. The outbreak of the First World War. And then the murder of activist Ginger Goodwin became too much to bear..."

items.text: How often do you find opportunities that pay for hotel/flights? We live in Maui and she is AMAZING! On camera. She’s also a gymnast and long distance runner. She really wants to get on the camera but it’s been tough. It seems like many people only want local hires. We can easily be there she is in a hybrid school that’s extremely flexible with schedules. Hawaii has some random modeling here and there but her heart is in acting.

topComments.text: Does she have a talent agent? That would be your first step to getting those kind of potential opportunities.

We live on big island and travel to oahu or cali to film mostly also went to Atlanta for filming moana and New Zealand for cheif of war . Once you land even a background role in hawaii the casting agents rember you and send out early auditions befor anyone else .

sharedPost.text:
🩰✨ LITTLE FEET, BIG DREAMS! ✨🩰

Our Saturday morning Tap & Ballet classes at All the Arts are the perfect introduction to the wonderful world of dance! 🌟

Designed for children aged 3–6 years, our fun and engaging classes help little dancers develop confidence, coordination, musicality and rhythm, all whilst making new friends and having lots of fun!

With 30 minutes of Tap and 30 minutes of Ballet, our young performers enjoy the best of both worlds, learning essential dance techniques in a nurturing and encouraging environment.

Our classes also follow the IDTA dance syllabus, giving children the opportunity to work towards recognised dance examinations as they progress.

🩰 Saturdays | 8.45–9.45am
📍 New Eltham
🌟 Ages 3–6 years

Whether your little one dreams of dancing on stage or simply loves moving to music, we’d love to welcome them to All the Arts!

Confidence starts here. ⭐

🌐 www.allthearts.co.uk

#AllTheArts #TapAndBallet #LittleDancers #NewEltham #DanceClasses #confidencestartshere

#funthursday #thursdayfun #FunWorkout #liverpoolfitness #dancefitness

sharedPost.text:
Smashed it last night in ADULT BEGINNERS! Quick session, all learned in an hour, drilling out the moves and working on our speed of movement in a faster, more commercial routine. Is it perfection? No! But for an hours hard graft they ROCKED IT! 🥰🙌 And the vibe was insane! 👌

Why not come and join us next time? This class is for anybody, even if you haven’t danced before!! With my guidance you’ll be amazed what you can do! (Details in the comments.) 

#liverpooldance #beginnersdance #liverpoolfitness #Liverpool #starttheweek

🎅 SANTA WANTED! 🎅
We’re looking for one more Santa to join our team this Christmas!

Short notice, I know, but unfortunately we’ve had a drop due to personal circumstances.

We’re based in Formby, with rehearsals taking place next week.

The dates are:

20th November to 18th December: Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays

19th to 24th December: Every day

If you’re interested and available, please drop me a message as soon as possible!

Thanks so much for considering, and please feel free to share!

LA MAGIE OPÈRE AU SIAO !

Accrochez-vous et ouvrez grand les yeux ! Les acrobates sont en action et le spectacle est tout simplement époustouflant. 😍

Jouer avec le feu, le manipuler et même le manger comme si de rien n'était… Voilà des prouesses qui laissent les festivaliers sans voix ! 🔥😱

Le Burkina Faso regorge de talents, de créativité et de potentialités qui méritent d'être connus et valorisés.

Au SIAO, le talent n'a décidément aucune limite !

🎥 Regardez la magie opérer avec Nexus Studio !

CASTING CALL:
We are looking for 1 older Black female actress who can do a Nigerian accent and 1 young Black actress who presents masc. We are casting for 2 world premiere plays that are written by 2 local playwrights in the Denver metro area. Performances are December 12 & 13. Rehearsals expected to begin in November. 

The Phase: A lesbian couple from two different cultures must slap on happy faces to prove to their traditional mothers that their gay love is not just a phase. {Casting for an older Black actress to do a Nigerian accent.}

We Need to Talk: A Lesbian Fever Dream: Newly almost u-hauling lesbians Mina and Blessing have some things to talk about before they move in. But they are so blinded by the intensity that they don’t stop to question if it’s really love. Mina falls into a fever dream that helps her work through what’s blocking their communication. {Casting for a young Black actress to present masc}.

At this time this is unpaid, but we aspire to provide compensation if profit has been made from ticket sales. Please fill out this this form: https://forms.gle/PntywLtLWTjmP1JX8 or email moodytingsllc@gmail.com to be considered. Thank you!

items.text:
CASTING CALL FOR AUDIO DRAMA 

TITLE: The Haunted Man: A Charles Dickens Christmas Story

GENRE: Drama

LOGLINE: A professor of chemistry at a school in 19th century England is haunted by a phantom and the memories of his past leading him to infect those around him with his curse and learn his own valuable lesson about forgiveness and compassion. 

ROLES: (American or British Accents)

**Redlaw/Phantom:** (60’s) An older chemistry professor who is affable and kindly but gets lost in his own pain. Also plays Redlaw’s Phantom

**Narrator:** An older, wisened voice,  Introduction, Outro and a few transitions

**Milly Swidger:** (40’s-50’s) The anecdote to Redlaw’s curse, sweet, compassionate, loving, humble

**William Swidger:** (40’s-50’s) Super talkative keeper of the school grounds, Milly’s husband

**Philip Swidger:** (80’s) William’s Dad who values every memory including the bad ones

**Johnny Tetterby/Wild Boy:** (8-12) A young boy, in charge of caring for his baby sister, well’ behaved but tried. The Wild boy is a juxtaposition of a boy raised wild and never knowing compassion and love.

**Adolphus Tetterby:** (30’s - 40’s) Johnny’s father, a struggling newspaper salesman, calm and level-headed until he’s not.

**Sophia  Tetterby:** (30’s - 40’s) Johnny’s mother, an overworked housewife, wishing she could spurge more this holiday season

**Edmund: **(18 - mid-20’s) The son of Redlaw’s former lover and betraying friend, lies ill and is cared for by Milly

**Longford:** (60’s) Redlaw’s betraying friend who stole his love and then gambled away his life, abandoning his wife and Edmund

**George:** (40’s-50’s) Philip Swidger’s other son who fell into bad company and is currently close to death

**Little Tetterby #1, 2 & 3:** (2-6) Some of the many Tetterby children causing commotion and chaos in the house.

PRODUCTION COMPANY: Storybook Creative

DIRECTOR: Austin Anderson

PRODUCTION TYPE: AUDIO DRAMA

CONTACT: Austin@storybookcreative.co

RUN TIME: ~100 minutes

COMPENSATION: Unpaid

UNION STATUS: Non-Union

AUDITION INFORMATION: Self Tape or in-person

SHOOT DATES: 1-2 shoot days, aiming for the weekend of November 14th and 15th. 

Cheers!

topComments.text: I can voice over - and I do have some friends who can as well

Stagebugz Theatre is seeking performers and groups of all kinds for our winter variety show on December 3rd! 

For the actors in the group: scenes, comedy routines, strong monologues, improv performances are all welcome! 

Auditions are November 15th at Columbine Library, or via self-tape. Sign up at this link: https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10C0E4CADAF22A7F5C52-65823774-tricks#/ 

Or email stagebugztheatre@gmail.com for self tape instructions.

This is a volunteer opportunity; however all performers are invited to a post-show reception with lots of food and prizes!

Stagebugz Theatre is a 501(c)3 non-profit dedicated to making arts education more accessible to youth in our community. To learn more about us, visit www.stagebugztheatre.com/

We hope to see you there!

Casting call: You Like It Here
VFS student short film | Psychological horror

Hi everyone! We’re looking for four actors for You Like It Here.

On Sabrina’s first night in Norway, unsettling events unfold as her overprotective mother’s presence becomes increasingly suspicious.

Filming dates & location
Nov 28 -Nov 29, Greater Vancouver Area (specific locations TBC)

Compensation
Unpaid. Craft service provided.

Union status: Non Union

Roles (playing ages)
* Sabrina: Female, 18–25, any ethnicity
* Olivia: Female, 40–50, any ethnicity
* Ingrid: Female, 40–65, Scandinavian
* Erik: Male, 40–65, Scandinavian

The attached casting breakdowns have more about each character.

To apply
Email your headshot, resume and demo reel to farfromhomep@gmail.com by November 18, 2026. Please include the role you’re applying for.
Selected applicants will receive the script and self-tape instructions by email. Shortlisted actors will then be invited to an in-person callback.

Thanks for taking a look! Please pass this along to anyone who might be interested.

Kino Klub is like a book club, but for movies and TV shows. 

Open to everyone! Free entry, registration required. 

Snacks and beverages will be available to buy at the café.

Spots are limited, so register soon via the ticket link!

🎬 **CASTING – NAUCZYCIELKA (ROLA MÓWIONA)**

📅 **DATA: 5.11 (CZWARTEK) – GODZINY POPOŁUDNIOWE**

📍 **LOKALIZACJA: WARSZAWA, GROCHÓW**

💰 **STAWKA: 250 ZŁ**

Do odcinka serialu internetowego poszukujemy aktorki do roli nauczycielki geografii.

**Rola obejmuje jedną krótką scenę w sali lekcyjnej.**

**Wymagania:**
* Wiek ekranowy: 35–55 lat
* Mile widziane doświadczenie aktorskie
* dostępność na terenie Warszawy (nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu)

**Zgłoszenia prosimy przesyłać w wiadomości prywatnej, dołączając:**
* Imię i nazwisko
* Wiek
* Aktualne zdjęcia
* **Demo aktorskie lub próbki dotychczasowych występów.** W przypadku braku takich materiałów prosimy o nagranie krótkiej, autorskiej scenki w roli nauczycielki prowadzącej lekcję (np. próbującej zapanować nad niesforną klasą).

❗ **Prosimy o przesyłanie materiałów aktorskich od razu ze zgłoszeniem. Zgłoszenia bez nagrań nie będą rozpatrywane.**

Zastrzegamy sobie kontakt wyłącznie z wybranymi kandydatkami.

**Hej, szukamy uczestników do streamów rozrywkowych za $**

Uruchamiamy rozrywkowe live show w Warszawie. Płacimy 150–300 zł za udział w 1,5-godzinnym streamie.

Format pierwszego - rozśmiesz oponenta. 
Jeden uczestnik ma rozśmieszyć drugiego za minutę. 
Jeżeli zaśmieje się, to ma zakręcić kołem fortuny i wykonać karę. 
Jeżeli nie zaśmieje się, to wykonać karę ma osoba, która śmieszyła. 

Jeżeli chcesz wziąć udział - napisz na priv albo na **kanapa@kanapastrips.pl**

FLIGHTTIME PRODUCTIONS
FINAL OPEN CASTING CALL

DIVA AIRWAYS: THE RISE & FALL

A Three-Act Comedy-Drama | World Premiere — Chicago, 2027

NON-UNION ACTORS ONLY | PAID ROLES

FlightTime Productions is seeking talented and dedicated performers for its upcoming world-premiere production of Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall, written and directed by Matthew Stevens.

Join us for this exciting original comedy-drama filled with laughter, friendship, family, workplace rivalries, and unexpected turbulence!

OPEN AUDITION INFORMATION

Monday, November 9, 2026

11:00 AM – 4:00 PM

West Loop Branch Library — Meeting Room

122 N. Aberdeen Street

Chicago, IL 60607

NO APPOINTMENT NECESSARY!

Audition check-in closes promptly at 4:00 PM.

AVAILABLE ROLES

All roles offer an $800 performance stipend.

* COLIN (16+) — Alexa’s caring younger brother, struggling with complicated family relationships.

* TIFFANY BELMONT (16+) — Miss Brooks’ stylish, ambitious, outspoken, and hilariously unpredictable assistant.

* BROOKLYN (16+) — The rival airline CEO’s daughter, whose loyalty begins to shift toward Diva Airways.

* SABRINA (25+) — A hardworking, loyal airline lounge manager confronting the company’s financial challenges.

AUDITION REQUIREMENTS

Please prepare a 1–2 minute comedic or dramatic monologue and bring a current headshot and acting résumé. Performers will also participate in group improvisation activities.

CALLBACKS — BY INVITATION ONLY

Friday, November 13, 2026 | 10:00 AM

Pullman Branch Library

11001 S. Indiana Avenue

Chicago, IL 60628

REHEARSALS & PERFORMANCES

Rehearsals Begin: January 10, 2027

Technical Rehearsals: April 4–7, 2027

Performance Engagement: April 8 – May 30, 2027

QUESTIONS & CASTING INQUIRIES

divaairwaysstage@gmail.com

Please note: West Loop Branch Library is not affiliated with or a sponsor of this production.

FLIGHTTIME PRODUCTIONS

Where the drama is first class, the comedy is nonstop, and the turbulence is guaranteed!

items.text:
Question for parents of child models!/ performers❤️
I’ve been researching how to get a trust account set up for my daughter as she begins her modeling journey, along with obtaining a work permit for her to work in New York.

I’m seeing different options for setting up a trust account, some through paid services and others that you can establish yourself for little to no cost.

For parents who have been through this process:

* How did you go about setting up your child’s trust account?

* Is it better to do it yourself or use a service?

* What is the process for obtaining a New York child performer work permit?

Any advice, recommendations, or resources would be greatly appreciated! I’m just trying to make sure I have everything in place and do things the right way for her. 💕

topComments.text: I would also recommend a roth IRA. Adding money at a young age makes interest earned skyrocket and sets them up for retirement.

Trust info depends on where you are located and where you will primarily be working 

In NYC a UTMA is sufficient.   You do not have to have a Coogan.  
UTMA we obtained through our credit union.  Some large banks also have them (Wells Fargo, PNC, Chase, etc).  Go to your bank or Credit Union and see if a UTMA is available.   
The biggest benefit of UTMA is you can access those funds and move them to high yield CDs or Roth Accts.  

If working in Chicago or LA a Coogan is required.  Coogans just kinda sit.  Most banks that offer Coogans you can't put into CDs or high yeild savings. So they earn little to nothing and can't be accessed until child is an adult.  
Coogans you can get through Actors Federal Credit ( online) or Wells Fargo.  But Wells Fargo you have to currently have a worked job, not just an agent.  

So my suggestion.   
Open a UTMA.  That is sufficient most states.  If you plan on spreading to markets where Coogan is required, then open Coogan only for the earning from those states that require. 

My kids will have more "income" from the high yeild CD interest and Roth, then they will have actually earned working.  So for us everything that can go into UTMA does.

Do kolejnego listopadowego odcinka 2. sezonu fabularnego serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję aktorów do następujących ról:

1.Bocian (35) – postawny, łysy, tatuaże, agresywny, porywczy, typ gangusa  - prawo jazdy
Data: 11 i 12. listopada
Stawka: 1600 zł netto za całość

2.Artur (27) – pracownik lakierni samochodowej. Dobrze zbudowany, postawny, krótkie włosy. Konkretny, chętnie rozmawia z policją.
Data: 11 listopada
Stawka: 600 zł netto

3.Stróż (60) – stróż pracujący na złomowisku. Ciekawski, interesuje się wszystkim dookoła. 
Data: 12 listopada
Stawka: 400 zł netto

4.Gangster 3 (41) – Gangster zatrzymany na złomowisku. Wysoki, chudy, tatuaże. Na początku nie chce pracować z policją, ale dociśnięty sypie wszystkich współpracowników.
Data: 12 i 13 listopada
Stawka: 1600 zł netto za całość

Chętnych aktorów zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania
9. Data lub odcinek grania w pierwszym sezonie Gliniarzy Śląsk

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

CASTING CALL — THE BROS SHOW
**SIX ROLES AVAILABLE | SOUTH OR WEST LONDON**

**Unpaid acting opportunities | Independent South London sitcom**

We're expanding the cast of *The Bros Show* and looking for new actors to join our independent comedy series!

*The Bros Show* is a South London teen sitcom combining chaotic comedy, friendship, rivalry, everyday life and mockumentary-style filming. We're looking for people who can bring characters to life through natural acting, personality, banter and strong reactions.

**ROLES AVAILABLE**
1. Lainey — Christmas Special

Guest / Special appearance

Playing age: 17

Description: A confident, blunt and mysterious girl with a long history with Aweys, Abdi and Aiden. She has a habit of appearing unexpectedly, making sarcastic remarks and acting like nothing bothers her.

Character base:
* Childhood friend of the original Bros.
* Childhood partners in crime with Aweys.
* Shares a secret handshake with Aweys.
* Protective of Abdi.
* Enjoys teasing Aiden.
* Has unresolved feelings for Aweys.
* Independent, stubborn and fiercely loyal.

Christmas Special purpose: Her return introduces an unexpected reunion, old memories and a little romantic tension.

**2. POSH BIRD 2**

Playful, mischievous and outspoken. She's always ready to join the group's banter, stir things up and bring chaotic energy to a scene.

**3. POSH BIRD 4**

The wildcard of the group. Flirty, cocky, forceful and unpredictable, she brings tension to the story, particularly through her rivalry with Lainey. This role needs someone who can balance confidence, humour and dramatic presence.

**4. AUNTIE 2**

One half of the auntie duo. We're looking for an actress with expressive reactions, natural delivery, personality and good comedic timing who can bounce off another performer.

**5.** MA-JAX

A cheeky, street-smart teenager from New Harbour who is secretly sort of a prince. Despite his royal connections, he spends most of his time chilling and hanging out with the Bros. His ridiculously grand full name is James Penthony Alexander Jones Max the 8th, but everyone calls him Ma-Jax. He and Aweys operate like partners, often teaming up and coming up with ideas together, while he gets along well with Abdi. However, he has constant beef with Aiden, who regularly throws him out of the house in a running gag reminiscent of Jazz from The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air. He also has an ongoing rivalry with Callum. Most of the others aren't particularly fond of him, although Diva Girl has a soft spot for him. We're looking for an actor with confidence, cheeky personality, natural British delivery, expressive reactions and excellent comedic timing who can bring his chaotic relationships and royal background to life.

**6. PC THOMPSON**

A police constable with a grounded, believable presence. We're looking for clear dialogue, natural acting and strong reactions, with the ability to work well alongside another performer.

1. Posh Bird 3 

 basically herself, playful the quietest most chirpful in the group and doesn't give a damn about the rivaliry simiar to baby spice from the spice girls 

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**
* Natural acting and believable dialogue.
* Good comedic timing and expressive reactions.
* Confidence performing from a short script.
* Reliability and willingness to take direction.
* Availability for agreed rehearsals and filming.

Professional acting experience is welcome but not essential. Applicants should be willing to learn lines and take part in a self-tape audition.

**LOCATION REQUIREMENT**

Applicants must be based in **South or West London** and able to travel to agreed filming and rehearsal locations.

**SELF-TAPE DEADLINES**

Shortlisted applicants will normally have **3 days to submit their self-tape**, with a maximum of **5 days** where that is the agreed deadline.

If you need additional time, contact the casting team before your deadline. Reasonable extensions may be agreed.

Please take deadlines seriously. If an applicant repeatedly misses an agreed deadline without communicating, their audition may be withdrawn and another candidate considered.

**PRODUCTION TERMS**
* This is an unpaid independent production.
* Travel, food and other expenses are not guaranteed.
* Filming dates, rehearsal arrangements and locations will be discussed with shortlisted applicants before any commitment.
* Applicants under 18 must involve a parent or guardian in the casting and production arrangements.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Please send:
1. Your preferred name.
2. Your age.
3. Your general location (South or West London).
4. Recent photos.
5. Acting experience or a showreel, if available.
6. Your availability for rehearsals and filming.
7. Which role or roles you would like to audition for.

Please don't send your full home address or other sensitive personal information.

Shortlisted applicants will receive further audition instructions and their self-tape scene.

**ABOUT THE PROJECT**

We're building a cast for an original independent series, and this is an opportunity to be part of a developing creative project. Please apply only if you're comfortable with the unpaid terms and can communicate reliably with the production team.

**THE BROS SHOW — Seven ROLES. ONE CHAOTIC UNIVERSE.**

If you're interested, get in touch and tell us which character you'd like to play!

𝗖𝗮𝗻 𝗜 𝗷𝗼𝗶𝗻 𝘆𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗺𝗮𝘀𝘀𝗮𝗴𝗲 𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗶𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗻𝗼 𝗲𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲?
​
Yes — and many of our students are career changers.
​
They come from very different backgrounds: tech, yoga, dance, hospitality, office jobs, creative work. Some already work with the body, others are starting completely from scratch.
​
That mix is part of the training. You don’t need to arrive already knowing how to massage. You learn the foundations step by step.
​
So if massage is something you’re considering as a new professional direction, lack of previous experience is not a barrier.
​

Start: January 23
4 places left

items.text:
Hi guys! For conversational purposes only. 
I’m starting an acting career and noticing many people in the industry also being content creators. I do not like social media nor would like to be a content creator but it feels like nowadays it’s a must. What do you think about that? Is it actually helpful to build a career or not?

topComments.text: Can’t really speak to the theatrical world, but I’m a commercial agent and 90% of castings ask me to include my clients’ social links in their submission. I don’t think following matters for *most jobs, but a presence is generally necessary nowadays
It takes a lot of work and time and that's less focus on the "acting"...

🎬 **CASTING DO TELEDYSKU RAPOWEGO | Bielsko-Biała, 12.11 lub 13.11 (któryś z tych dni - jeden dzień zdjęciowy)**

**POSZUKUJĘ:**

**STATYŚCI, 18-30 lat: 100 zł gotówką od razu po planie**
Energia, żywioł, blokowe klimaty. Domówka rodem z blokowiska albo scena przy starym aucie pod blokiem.

Tytuł maila: **STATYŚCI KLIP 12.11**-**13.11**

**STATYŚCI, 30–50 lat: 100 zł netto gotówką od razu po planie**
Imieniny u szalonej ciotki: schludnie przy stole, ale z luzem.
Tytuł maila: **STATYŚCI URODZINY CIOTKI 12.11-13.11**

**EPIZODYŚCI, 40–60 lat: 500 zł netto płatne po planie**
Charyzmatyczni szaleni wujkowie rodem z PRL na imieninach u ciotki.
Tytuł maila: **EPIZODYSTA KLIP 12.11-13.11**

**W zgłoszeniu:** imię i nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, zdjęcie twarzy i sylwetki bez filtrów. Epizodyści dodatkowo link do wizytówki na YouTube.

📩 karina.szymocha@gmail.com
⏰ Na zgłoszenia czekam do jutra (05.11), do 18:00

Szukam chętnych osób do bezpłatnej sesji zdjęciowej, którą chcę dołączyć do swojego portfolio.

Wydarzenie odbędzie się w najbliższą sobotę, 07.11.2026 r., w malowniczej scenerii Gdańskiego Starego Miasta.

⏱ Godziny: 10:00 – 13:00 (dokładną godzinę ustalimy indywidualnie).
👶👵 Wiek uczestników: Bez ograniczeń – zapraszam każdego!

Do wyboru różne formaty sesji plenerowych (realizowanych na dworze):
 Sesja indywidualna / portretowa
 Sesja dla par
 Sesja dziecięca
 Sesja ze zwierzakiem 🐾
 Sesja do wizytówki aktorskiej
 Sesja wyłącznie twarzy (close-up)
 Sesja dowolna (np. z wybranym przez Ciebie przedmiotem lub stylizacją)

📩 Jak się zgłosić?
Napisz wiadomość e-mail na adres: oliwia.kapacewicz@gmail.com
W treści zgłoszenia podaj:
1. Imię i nazwisko
2. Wiek
3. Aktualne zdjęcie (selfie lub zdjęcie sylwetki)

Zapraszam do kontaktu!

🎬 CASTING DO TELEDYSKU RAPOWEGO | Bielsko-Biała, 12.11 lub 13.11 (któryś z tych dni - jeden dzień zdjęciowy)

POSZUKUJĘ:

STATYŚCI, 18-30 lat: 100 zł gotówką od razu po planie
Energia, żywioł, blokowe klimaty. Domówka rodem z blokowiska albo scena przy starym aucie pod blokiem.

Tytuł maila: STATYŚCI KLIP 12.11-13.11

STATYŚCI, 30–50 lat: 100 zł netto gotówką od razu po planie
Imieniny u szalonej ciotki: schludnie przy stole, ale z luzem.
Tytuł maila: STATYŚCI URODZINY CIOTKI 12.11-13.11

EPIZODYŚCI, 40–60 lat: 500 zł netto płatne po planie
Charyzmatyczni szaleni wujkowie rodem z PRL na imieninach u ciotki.
Tytuł maila: EPIZODYSTA KLIP 12.11-13.11

W zgłoszeniu: imię i nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, zdjęcie twarzy i sylwetki bez filtrów. Epizodyści dodatkowo link do wizytówki na YouTube.

📩 karina.szymocha@gmail.com
⏰ Na zgłoszenia czekam do jutra (05.11), do 18:00

🎬 KRAKÓW epizodyści do filmu dyplomowego NON PROFIT

Do realizacji filmu dyplomowego poszukujemy osób chętnych do udziału w zdjęciach w rolach epizodycznych.

 

Poszukujemy:

 

👵 STARUSZKA – mężczyzny w wieku 70+

👩‍⚕️ PIELĘGNIARKI – kobiety w wieku około 30 lat

🚑 RATOWNIKA MEDYCZNEGO – mężczyzny w wieku około 30 lat

 

Termin zdjęć: jeden z dni 17, 18, 19, 20 lub 21 listopada.

 

W zgłoszeniu prosimy o:

- imię i nazwisko,

- wiek,

- aktualne zdjęcie,

- video wizytówkę (jeśli posiadasz),

- daty dostępności.

 

📩 Osoby zainteresowane prosimy o przesłanie maila na adres: **marzena.casting@gmail.com.**

 

W tytule wiadomości prosimy wpisać odpowiednio: „**Staruszek – dyplom**”, „**Pielęgniarka – dyplom**”,  „**Ratownik – dyplom**”.

Christmas music video
Looking for production assistants/crew members  for a Christmas music video. We will be filming November 14th and 15th. All help is welcomed and greatly appreciated! If you can only help for one of the days that’s fine too. This music video is to bring the Christmas alive! So we ready to dance and stay active for a good part of the day. 

Also looking for dancers and extras. Experience is not needed. 

Unpaid, lunch provided, demo footage, resume experience. 

If you are interested please email kristanleclerc77@gmail.com

Crew members and Production assistants contact email above. 

If you are interested in being a dancer or extra Please include a video of you dancing, email, and head shot. 

Thank you all. Have a wonderful day!

Thank you!

Do realizacji filmu dyplomowego poszukujemy osób chętnych do udziału w zdjęciach w rolach epizodycznych.

 

Poszukujemy:

 

👵 STARUSZKA – mężczyzny w wieku 70+

👩‍⚕️ PIELĘGNIARKI – kobiety w wieku około 30 lat

🚑 RATOWNIKA MEDYCZNEGO – mężczyzny w wieku około 30 lat

 

Termin zdjęć: jeden z dni 17, 18, 19, 20 lub 21 listopada.

 

W zgłoszeniu prosimy o:

- imię i nazwisko,

- wiek,

- aktualne zdjęcie,

- video wizytówkę (jeśli posiadasz),

- daty dostępności.

 

📩 Osoby zainteresowane prosimy o przesłanie maila na adres: **marzena.casting@gmail.com.**

 

W tytule wiadomości prosimy wpisać odpowiednio: „**Staruszek – dyplom**”, „**Pielęgniarka – dyplom**”,  „**Ratownik – dyplom**”.

Do kolejnego listopadowego odcinka 2. sezonu fabularnego serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję aktorów do następujących ról:

1.Bocian (35) – postawny, łysy, tatuaże, agresywny, porywczy, typ gangusa  - prawo jazdy
Data: 11 i 12. listopada
Stawka: 1600 zł netto za całość

2.„Pilczak” (39) – szczupły, wysoki, może mieć tatuaże, blizny, dłuższe włosy
Data: 11 i 12. listopada
Stawka: 1600 zł netto za całość

3.Ilona (39) – żona Pawła. Skromna, przestraszona całą sytuacją. Skromnie ubrana, lekki makijaż lub brak.
Data: 11 listopada
Stawka: 800 zł netto

4.Witek(58) – serdeczny, dobry człowiek. Zmartwiony losem konkurent. Ubrany w ubranie robocze.  
Data: 11 listopada
Stawka: 700 zł netto

5.Artur (27) – pracownik lakierni samochodowej. Dobrze zbudowany, postawny, krótkie włosy. Konkretny, chętnie rozmawia z policją.
Data: 11 listopada
Stawka: 600 zł netto

6.Bartek (32) – pracownik w lakierni samochodowej oraz informator policji. Szczupły, lubi biegać, krótkie włosy, ubrany w sportowe ubrania.
Data: 11 i 12 listopada 
Stawka: 1400 zł netto za całość

7.Stróż (60) – stróż pracujący na złomowisku. Ciekawski, interesuje się wszystkim dookoła. 
Data: 12 listopada
Stawka: 400 zł netto

8.Gangster 3 (41) – Gangster zatrzymany na złomowisku. Wysoki, chudy, tatuaże. Na początku nie chce pracować z policją, ale dociśnięty sypie wszystkich współpracowników.
Data: 12 i 13 listopada
Stawka: 1600 zł netto za całość

Chętnych aktorów zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania
9. Data lub odcinek grania w pierwszym sezonie Gliniarzy Śląsk

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

**Casting a young (14-18) hispanic actress **to play ‘Young Sierra’ in Level Up, a Project DU F.I.L.M. production and an episode of the ‘Womanhood’ series.

**Logline:** When a self-doubting female gamer with an invisible disability, is called upon for a game design instructor teaching demo, she must defeat the demons in her mind to prove her worth.

**Character Description:**

**Young Sierra [Female] [Hispanic] [Dark Brown Hair] [Brown Eyes] [Age 14-18]**

Young Sierra has a secret: she loves playing games. It might not seem like a big secret to many, but she’s learned not to tell anyone. All the adversity she’s faced in the gaming space led to her creating a new gamer tag, ‘Cyrus’, so no boys will bully her for being a girl gamer. Make no mistake, she’ll never let anyone take gaming away from her and the bullying has only made her more determined to make an impact on the gaming space when she grows up.

**Compensation:** Actors will be compensated. Minor roles: $50/day. Needed for 1 day. Actors will also receive film credit, meals and crafty on set, footage for demo reels, and a digital copy of the final film.

**Union Status:** Non-Union

**Shooting Information:** Filming in the University of Denver and surrounding neighborhood during December 13-15.

**Audition Information:** Please send your headshot and resume to *levelupproduction2026@gmail.com*. You will receive a side and more information after.

All the adversity she’s faced in the gaming space led to her creating a new gamer tag, ‘Cyrus’, so no boys will bully her for being a girl gamer. Make no mistake, she’ll never let anyone take gaming away from her and the bullying has only made her more determined to make an impact on the gaming space when she grows up.

**Compensation:** Actors will be compensated. Minor roles: $50/day. Needed for 1 day. Actors will also receive film credit, meals and crafty on set, footage for demo reels, and a digital copy of the final film.

**Union Status:** Non-Union

**Shooting Information:** Filming in the University of Denver and surrounding neighborhood during December 13-15.

**Audition Information:** Please send your headshot and resume to *levelupproduction2026@gmail.com*. You will receive a side and more information after.

Hey filmy, theatrey, comedy, improvy, dancey, musically, artsy, photography, videography, writery, televisiony, industrialy, voice overy, productiony, investory, small businessy, or just curiousy friends!!!

Next Saturday the CFVA (Colorado Film & Video Association) is hosting it’s annual Town Hall event and I HIGHLY encourage you to come. There will be satellite events all over the state, so if you are not in Denver, don’t worry. You are not left out! 

This year we are focusing on creating connections and a more cohesive community. A community for all and we want to hear YOUR voice. We want you to be a big part of the discussion. Your ideas and thoughts matter. So come and share them! 

If you have not been to a Town Hall before, this is a different event than a schmoozer. At the Town Hall, we actually discuss the trajectory of our industry and how to make it better - in large groups and in small break out groups. It’s where we get things done and when intentions get set.

Here are the details. I genuinely hope you attend and help make our community better, stronger and more undeniable! 

RSVP for your region
Saturday, November 14
Join us for the third Film and Media Town Hall now run by the CFVA.

This is the continuation of a series of community-led events aimed to foster statewide collaboration among creatives and media professionals.This state-wide event will take place simultaneously in EIGHT CITIES ACROSS OUR STATE and with an online virtual option for those of you traveling or unable to make one of the locations.

Our goal? To unite our community to grow a strong, thriving film and media industry in Colorado.

The topic? Community Connections - how do we break down the silos

Please RSVP below, so we know how many people will attend each location.

This event is free for everyone to attend thanks to our generous group of volunteers and sponsors: The CFVA, OEDIT CO Office of Film, Television and Media, The City of Lakewood, Mass FX Media, and LoCo+.

Do kolejnego listopadowego odcinka 2. sezonu fabularnego serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję aktorów do następujących ról:

1.Bocian (35) – postawny, łysy, tatuaże, agresywny, porywczy, typ gangusa  - prawo jazdy
Data: 11 i 12. listopada
Stawka: 1600 zł netto za całość

2.Artur (27) – pracownik lakierni samochodowej. Dobrze zbudowany, postawny, krótkie włosy. Konkretny, chętnie rozmawia z policją.
Data: 11 listopada
Stawka: 600 zł netto

3.Stróż (60) – stróż pracujący na złomowisku. Ciekawski, interesuje się wszystkim dookoła. 
Data: 12 listopada
Stawka: 400 zł netto

4.Gangster 3 (41) – Gangster zatrzymany na złomowisku. Wysoki, chudy, tatuaże. Na początku nie chce pracować z policją, ale dociśnięty sypie wszystkich współpracowników.
Data: 12 i 13 listopada
Stawka: 1600 zł netto za całość

Chętnych aktorów zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania
9. Data lub odcinek grania w pierwszym sezonie Gliniarzy Śląsk

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

sharedPost.text: Flexibler Musikerstammtisch. Gestern, nachdem das vereinbarte Lokal Portugal aus welchem Grund auch immer verschlossen war, sind wir kurzerhand ins Saigon Delhi am Ostbahnhof umgezogen. Und das hat uns sehr positiv überrascht. Sehr gutes Essen, davon vieles auch vegan, sehr sauber und absolut freundlicher Service. Wie immer, waren wir alle gut drauf und hatten einen schönen Abend. Vlnr.: Wolfgang Dokoupil jetzt bei Pias-kultradio.at, Gilbert Bishop Frontman Soulissimo, Arcel Grace (Christmas must be tonight), Lizel, dann ich, Andy Exmoderator RDB und Urgestein Inge Hirn-Socher Promoterin.

CASTING CALL
The Star is an upcoming comedy-drama short film exploring fame, nostalgia, love and regret.

Set between the colourful music scene of 1980s Britain and the present day, the film follows an ageing popstar whose glory days are long behind him. When an unexpected visitor arrives with a connection to his past, he is forced to confront the memories, relationships and choices he has spent years avoiding.

Blending humour with heartfelt moments, The Star explores what happens when the world moves on, but you don't.

Please contact: thestarshortfilm@gmail.com - if interested:)

Film Speed-Friending: Quick one-to-one chats with fun film questions. 🎬
Moved to Copenhagen recently, or just want to meet new people and make friends? Film Speed-Friending is one of the easiest way to do it.

How it works:

Have one-to-one conversation with someone new

Pick a film question card, like “What’s your favourite movie?” or “Which film sequel was better than the original?”

Chat for a few minutes, then meet the next person

By the end of the event you’ll have met everyone in the room and maybe found some new friends!

Love films? Want to meet new people? This event is for you!

Join Film Society Denmark for an evening of film trivia, charades and a lot of laughs at Urban House Copenhagen!

Come with friends or come solo. Everyone gets a chance to be part of a team, so it’s one of the easiest ways to meet fellow film lovers in Copenhagen and make friends!

What’s in store:
Film trivia: classics, blockbusters, world cinema
Movie charades: act or guess the right movie name
🏆 Prizes for the winning team, plus a special award for the best charades performance

Spots are limited, so book your ticket early. See you there! 🍿

AUDITION PÅ MUSICALSENSATION! 🎭
Der er nu endelig åbnet for auditiontilmeldinger til Nyborg Voldspils næste store sommermusical under åben himmel: ”WE WILL ROCK YOU”, fyldt med 28 af de største hits fra det legendariske rockband Queen! Audition finder sted lørdag/søndag d. 21.-22. november 2026 i Nyborg. Tilmeld dig nu og bliv en del af den første udendørsopsætning på Fyn af den verdensberømte musical hos Danmarks ældste friluftsteater!

DER SØGES TIL FORESTILLINGEN:
30-40 skuespillere, sangere og dansere. Der er i forestillingen 7 solistroller og derudover en lang række bi- og ensembleroller med og uden replikker. Alle køn og aldre fra 15 år og op er velkomne til audition, uanset erfaring og baggrund. Forestillingen opføres i sommeren 2027 fra d. 16. juli til d. 7. august. Du kan læse alt om audition og tilmelding på Nyborg Voldspils hjemmeside, hvor man allerede også kan købe billetter til forestillingen: nyborgvoldspil.dk

ANGÅENDE ENSEMBLE, DANS OG KOR:
Ud over solist- og birollerne medvirker ensemblet løbende gennem forestillingen og har flere funktioner undervejs i både sange og scener (enkelte har også replikker). Ønsker man at gå til audition som danser uden at skulle synge eller have replikker, er dette også muligt. Selv om forestillingen hovedsageligt byder på rockmusik, er dansere af alle typer/genrer velkomne til audition, uanset erfaring. Går man til audition inden for sang og bliver udtaget til koret, synger man desuden med på mange af de 28 numre i forestillingen ud over at indgå i scener og koreografier.

ANGÅENDE ROLLER:
Du kan læse alt om de individuelle solistroller og biroller, samt hvad man skal forberede til audition, på Nyborg Voldspils hjemmeside her: nyborgvoldspil.dk

VI SES TIL AUDITION!
Vi glæder os til at se mange skønne auditiondeltagere af alle typer og aldre fra 15 år og op d. 21.-22. november. Tilmeld dig nu via følgende link og gå ikke glip af chancen for at få en uforglemmelig sommer med Nyborg Voldspils brag af en opsætning af ”We Will Rock You”: nyborgvoldspil.dk

Nyborg Voldspil præsenterer:
”WE WILL ROCK YOU”
16. juli – 7. august 2027
Instruktør: Rasmus Mansachs
Sanginstruktør/korleder: Johnny Jørgensen
Koreograf: Fie Alberte Damgaard-Lauritsen
Scenograf: Louise Dencker Rasmussen
Kostumier: Jannie Lindhard Pedersen
Orkesterleder: Tuomas Korhonen
Billetsalg og auditiontilmelding: nyborgvoldspil.dk
